name: Village Schoolhouse
description: Three-storey brick-and-stone école communale, 20 m long. A corridor along the back on every floor links two separate stairwells at either end. Classrooms with desks and chalkboards, a teacher's room and a library. B2: brick with stone dressings: chamfered plinth, string courses at each floor, bevelled quoins, keystoned openings, a stepped cornice, three dormers, an octagonal bell turret on the ridge, capped chimneys, ivy on the west gable.
